title: Petunidin attenuates vinclozolin instigated testicular toxicity in albino rats via regulating TLR4/MyD88/TRAF6 and Nrf-2/Keap-1 pathway: A pharmacodynamic and molecular simulation approach.
authors: El Safadi, Mahmoud; Hassan, Hesham M; Ali, Adnan; Al-Emam, Ahmed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究花青素Petunidin对杀菌剂诱导大鼠睾丸毒性的保护作用，分子模拟仅用于小分子与Keap1/TLR4/StAR蛋白的对接，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Vinclozolin (VZN) is a widely used fungicide which exerts deleterious impacts on various organs including testis. Petunidin (PDN) is a polyphenolic compound that demonstrates a broad range of pharmacological activities. Thirty-two rats were divided into 4 groups including the control, VZN (100 mg/kg), VZN (100 mg/kg) + PDN (4 mg/kg) and PDN (4 mg/kg) treated group. The activities of antioxidant enzymes were assessed by using previously documented protocols. The gene expressions were determined by using qRT-PCR. The levels of hepatic function and apoptotic markers were evaluated by using standard ELISA technique. The histological analysis was carried out as per the standard protocol of histology. It was revealed that VZN disrupted the Nrf-2/Keap-1 pathway. Moreover, the activities of catalase (CAT), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), superoxide dismutase (SOD), heme-oxygenase-1 (HO-1) and glutathione reductase (GSR) were reduced whereas levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) & malondialdehyde (MDA) were promoted following the VZN intoxication. Furthermore, VZN intoxication reduced total sperm count, viability, motility as well as luteinizing hormone (LH), follicle stimulating hormone (FSH), and plasma testosterone. Besides, administration of VZN decreased the expressions of 3beta-Hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (3beta-HSD), steroidogenic acute regulatory protein (StAR) and 17beta-Hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (17beta-HSD). Moreover, VZN exposure escalated the expressions of Bcl-2-associated X protein (Bax) and cysteine-aspartic acid protease-3 (Caspase-3) while reducing the expressions of B-cell lymphoma-2 (Bcl-2). Additionally, VZN administration increased the gene expression of toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), tumor necrosis factor receptor-associated factor 6 (TRAF-6) and myeloid differentiation primary response 88 (MyD88). The levels of interleukin-6 (IL-6), nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB), interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), and the activity of cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) were promoted following the VZN administration. Furthermore, VZN intoxication disrupted the normal histology of testicular tissues. However, VZN + PDN treatment ameliorated testicular damage via regulating aforementioned dysregulations owing to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidative as well as anti-apoptotic potentials. Lastly, molecular docking (MD) was performed to assess the effectiveness of PDN as a curative compound by analyzing its binding affinity with the targeted proteins (Keap1, TLR4 and StAR). Our in-silico evaluations confirmed that PDN possesses the potential to interact with binding pockets of these proteins, emphasizing its capability as a curative compound to mitigate VZN-prompted reproductive damage.
abstract_zh: Vinclozolin (VZN) 是一种广泛使用的杀菌剂，对包括睾丸在内的多种器官产生有害影响。Petunidin (PDN) 是一种多酚类化合物，展现出广泛的药理活性。将32只大鼠分为4组，包括对照组、VZN（100 mg/kg）组、VZN（100 mg/kg）+ PDN（4 mg/kg）组和PDN（4 mg/kg）处理组。通过先前记录的方案评估抗氧化酶的活性。使用qRT-PCR测定基因表达。采用标准ELISA技术评估肝功能标志物和凋亡标志物的水平。组织学分析按照标准组织学方案进行。结果显示，VZN扰乱了Nrf-2/Keap-1通路。此外，在VZN中毒后，过氧化氢酶（CAT）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）和谷胱甘肽还原酶（GSR）的活性降低，而活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）的水平升高。进一步地，VZN中毒降低了总精子数、活力、运动性以及黄体生成素（LH）、卵泡刺激素（FSH）和血浆睾酮水平。此外，VZN给药降低了3β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶（3β-HSD）、类固醇生成急性调节蛋白（StAR）和17β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶（17β-HSD）的表达。同时，VZN暴露增加了Bcl-2相关X蛋白（Bax）和半胱氨酸-天冬氨酸蛋白酶-3（Caspase-3）的表达，同时降低了B细胞淋巴瘤-2（Bcl-2）的表达。另外，VZN给药增加了toll样受体4（TLR4）、肿瘤坏死因子受体相关因子6（TRAF-6）和髓样分化初级反应88（MyD88）的基因表达。VZN给药后，白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、肿瘤坏死因子-alpha（TNF-alpha）的水平以及环氧化酶-2（COX-2）的活性均升高。此外，VZN中毒扰乱了睾丸组织的正常组织学结构。然而，VZN + PDN处理通过调节上述失调，凭借其抗炎、抗氧化和抗凋亡潜力，改善了睾丸损伤。最后，进行了分子对接（MD）以评估PDN作为治疗化合物的有效性，通过分析其与靶蛋白（Keap1、TLR4和StAR）的结合亲和力。我们的计算机模拟评估确认，PDN具有与这些蛋白结合口袋相互作用的潜力，强调其作为治疗化合物减轻VZN诱导的生殖损伤的能力。
